title: TranscriptSchema
description: Output contract for the Capture stage. Contains all scraped utterances from the Zoom viewer transcript panel.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment MAJOR for breaking changes.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the capture session completed.

transcript_unavailable.description: True if the Zoom transcript panel was absent or empty during capture.

utterances.description: Time-ordered list of scraped utterances. Empty array if transcript_unavailable is true.

start_seconds.description: Playback position in seconds when this utterance began.

end_seconds.description: Playback position in seconds when this utterance ended. Must be > start_seconds.

speaker.description: Speaker display name from the Zoom transcript panel. Empty string if unknown.
